# Check the row where team 1 is "asc diaraf" and team 2 is "stade malien"
match_row = df[(df['team 1'] == 'asc diaraf') & (df['team 2'] == 'stade malien')]

if match_row.empty:
    answer = False
else:
    # Extract the aggregate score
    agg_score = match_row['agg'].iloc[0]
    # Parse the aggregate score to determine the winner
    # The format is "goals_team1 - goals_team2" possibly with extra info in parentheses
    # Split by space to get the score part before any parentheses
    score_part = agg_score.split()[0]
    # Ensure we have exactly two parts separated by '-'
    if '-' in score_part:
        team1_goals, team2_goals = map(int, score_part.split('-'))
        # Determine if asc diaraf (team 1) won (more goals)
        answer = team1_goals > team2_goals
    else:
        # If no '-' found, assume no valid score and asc diaraf did not win
        answer = False
